Title: Versículos de la Biblia para cumpleaños
Description: “Jehová te bendiga, y te guarde: Haga resplandecer Jehová su rostro sobre ti, y haya de ti misericordia: Jehová alce a ti su rostro, y ponga en ti paz.” (Números 6:24-26) Textos bíblicos para felicitar a un cumpleañero: bendiciones, gratitud por la vida y frases para mamá, hijos o abuelos. En Reina-Valera 1909.

Title: Bible verses for depression
Description: “I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears. My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.” (Psalms 6:6-7) Nineteen Bible verses for depression: lament psalms, godly people at their lowest, God near the crushed, and why seeing a doctor is not a lack of faith.

Title: Versículos de la Biblia para sanidad
Description: “Bendice, alma mía a Jehová, y no olvides ninguno de sus beneficios. El es quien perdona todas tus iniquidades, el que sana todas tus dolencias;” (Salmos 103:2-3) 16 versículos bíblicos de sanidad (Reina-Valera 1909) para orar por el cuerpo y el corazón, con una nota sobre quién los escribió y a quién.

Title: Bible verses about hope
Description: “Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.” (Psalms 62:5) Sixteen Bible verses about hope, grouped by where it comes from, how it holds in pain, how to wait, and what is promised. Each has a short note.

Title: Bible verses for loneliness
Description: “Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted. The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress. Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.” (Psalms 25:16-18) Sixteen Bible verses for when you feel alone: honest prayers, God's promise to stay near, and why we were made for people. A short note on each.

Title: Bible verses for overthinking
Description: “We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.” (2 Corinthians 10:5) Bible verses for overthinking, grouped by what your mind is doing: racing thoughts, hard decisions, replaying the past and sleepless nights.

Title: Bible verses about not giving up
Description: “Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.” (Galatians 6:9) Bible verses about not giving up when the road is long: 16 passages on endurance, getting back up after a fall, and mercy for tomorrow, with short notes.
